description: The China Land Surveying and Planning Institute compiled this one-kilometre grid of irrigation-canal and ditch density for Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei in 2020. It extracts channel skeleton lines from the National Land Change Survey and aggregates their spatial distribution into grid cells. The product describes the distribution of drainage and irrigation infrastructure and can support farmland-access and irrigation-planning scenarios. ScienceDB provides the dataset landing page and reuse documentation under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Access is free, with commercial use restricted and share-alike conditions applying. The inspected repository metadata leaves the file format unknown. Channel density does not provide hydraulic capacities or connected network topology, so flow simulations need additional geometry and operating information. No directly related catalogue record was identified for this regional density product.
